question: In March 2025, which 12-year-old swimmer set a record by completing the 17 km open-water swim from Gateway of India to Atal Setu?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tanay Tushar Lad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Tanay Tushar Lad**, a young and talented **12-year-old** swimmer, made headlines in **March 2025** by setting a new record in open-water swimming.
 
• He successfully completed a grueling **17 km** swim in the **Arabian Sea**, navigating the waters between two of Mumbai's most prominent landmarks.
 
• The swimming expedition commenced at the historic **Gateway of India** and concluded at the **Atal Setu**, which is also known as the **Mumbai Trans Harbour Link (MTHL)**.
 
• This specific route is considered challenging due to the unpredictable **tidal currents** and the maritime traffic in the **Mumbai harbour** area.
